From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Gray <elliot@ledgerly.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & POC prompt/log collection next steps

Thanks again for your time this morning, Elliot — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started on our side. Please reply with confirmations or changes.

High-level POC scope (as discussed)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference on your customer-support routing prompts and measure fallback rate / latency under typical load.
- Success criteria (mutually agreed):
  * >92% intent classification parity with Ledgerly baseline on a sampled test set (we’ll measure F1 on labeled subset)
  * Average generation latency <250ms p95 for 512-token window during simulated concurrency
  * No PII leakage incidents in 2k prompt sample after redaction checks

Deliverables we need from Ledgerly (ask):
1) Prompt/log bundle: 1,500–3,000 representative prompts + associated metadata (channel, timestamp, agent id if applicable). Preferred format: CSV with columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, channel, timestamp, outcome_label (optional). See attached ledgerly_prompt_sample_v1.csv for template.
2) Example golden responses / label file for ~300 evaluation prompts (for accuracy metrics).
3) Confirmation of redaction level you’re comfortable sharing (full PII redaction preferred). If you can only share identifiers, note that and we’ll provide a synthetic augmentation plan.
4) Security checklist note: IP allowlist and SAML SSO provisioning for RBAC (we’ll send the whitelist IPs and the SSO metadata).

Timeline (target):
- Nov 4: Ledgerly delivers prompt bundle + labels or status update
- Nov 9: Redwood ingests data, initial quality check and redaction report
- Nov 16: First eval sweep + metrics shared

Ownership on Redwood:
- Marissa Cole (marissa_cole) — data ingestion & redaction report
- Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer) — eval plan, metric definitions, and test harness execution
- Myself — POC coordination, success criteria sign-off, and executive updates

Attachments: ledgerly_prompt_sample_v1.csv (template), redwood_poc_timeline_v2.xlsx, NDA_Ledgerly_signed.pdf

Next actions for Ledgerly:
- Elliot: confirm you can deliver the prompt bundle by Nov 4 or share a revised date
- Procurement: send any required PO or procurement steps (cc’ing procurement here would help)
- Let us know if you need a redaction script from us (we can provide a small Python helper)

Thanks,
Naomi

Thanks, Naomi — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming a few items: 

1) Prompt bundle: We can export a cleaned set of ~2,200 prompts by COB Nov 4. We will run automated redaction to remove direct PII (names, SSNs) but will keep agent IDs as hashed strings. If you need stronger synthetic substitution we can discuss.
2) Labels: We’ll provide a 300-sample golden label file by Nov 6 (our QA team needs a couple of days).
3) Security: Procurement will follow up on the PO. For IP allowlisting — can you share the IP ranges and the SAML metadata?
4) Question: For the accuracy metric, is Redwood able to compute per-channel breakdowns (chat vs. email) in the initial sweep? That would be helpful.

I’m CC’ing our procurement contact to track PO / contract steps. We’ve reviewed the NDA and sent it back signed (attached on our end).
